architecture.title: The nightly harness review routine — Shadow, a human gate, and the boundary in code
architecture.caption: EXAMPLE design for this course (the fictional Ops Assistant), built in reviewkit.py on the SIM agent. The plain check is code over the event log: no weak signal, no model call. Human signals choose the wakes and travel to the domain editor as content, but never reach the anonymised selector. A draft becomes a version only through a named reviewer, and the approval boundary stays in the platform's enforcement point, outside every editable file.
